meta_description: Rendace Plastering delivers expert internal and external plastering across Birmingham. Fast turnaround, competitive rates, and flawless finishes. Call 07984 399889 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From damp repairs to complete internal finishes, we deliver smooth, lasting results on time and on budget.
services_subhead: We specialise in internal and external plastering, from small repairs to full renovation work.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional finishes on new walls, ceilings, and repairs. We leave surfaces ready for paint or wallpaper without a trace of imperfection.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant renders that protect your property and improve kerb appeal. Rapid curing systems mean less disruption to your day.

services.title: Damp Proofing & Remedial Work
services.desc: We identify and repair damp damage, applying specialist coatings to prevent recurring moisture problems and extend wall life.

services.title: Artex & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Textured or Artex ceiling and wall work, including removal and re-plastering of dated finishes with modern alternatives.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Touch-ups
services.desc: Small cracks, holes, and repairs matched to your existing finish. Same-day quotes available for urgent work.

services.title: New Build & Renovation
services.desc: Full plaster-to-paint service on new builds, extensions, and major renovations. We work to architect specs and project timelines.

about_pullquote: Every wall we finish, we'd be happy to live with ourselves.
about_para_1: Rendace Plastering was founded on the simple idea that plastering done right shouldn't cost the earth or take forever. With over 12 years' experience across Birmingham's domestic and commercial properties, we've built a reputation for clean work, honest pricing, and fast turnaround. We turn up on time, leave sites tidy, and deliver the kind of finish that homeowners and builders actually want to sign off on.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're rarely the slowest either. Our customers come back because they know we'll spot problems others miss—dodgy damp, uneven substrate, timing issues—and fix them properly the first time. Whether you're a homeowner with a leaking ceiling or a developer with 20 walls to finish, we treat every job as if it's our own home.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners and Builders Say

reviews.text: Had the whole of my 1930s semi replastered after some serious damp issues. Really meticulous job—they took time to prep walls properly and the finish is absolutely flawless. Mate, these lads know what they're doing. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Rendace did our extension skimming. Work was immaculate, they kept the site clean, and they actually finished a day early. Fair pricing too. They've already been back for a small patch repair and I didn't hesitate to call them. Top notch.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Called for an urgent ceiling repair after a leak. They came out within 48 hours, assessed the damp damage, and gave a no-nonsense quote. Fixed it properly and didn't just cover over the problem. Very professional and honest—exactly what you want in a tradesperson.
reviews.author: David L.
